name: visual-loop-skill
description: Dependencies for scripts/{ab-shot,pixel,sweep}.mjs only. Deliberately outside the root manifest and pinned exactly, like the diagram skill. Installed at build time into the image — see the Dockerfile's visual-loop deps RUN. The repo's dependency rule says to avoid sharp because node_modules is mounted across a macOS host and a Linux container; that hazard does not exist here: this tree is baked inside the image, built per architecture by the multi-arch matrix, and never shared with a host.
